mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.1%) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates sustained liquidity support.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% (UNRATE > 5.5%) indicates labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal collapsing consumer demand, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic activity expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate profit growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105, or Rank IC is below 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) reflect improving consumer confidence and economic activity, consistently generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to near-term demand strength.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% (CPIAUCSL > 2.5) signals accelerating price pressures, prompting Federal Reserve tightening expectations that reduce equity valuations and cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Weak employment growth (PAYEMS < 100k) combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE > 0.2pp monthly increase) signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS < 100k and UNRATE rises, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.25% in prior month) increase borrowing costs and dampen economic growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in policy contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises by 0.25% or more, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.
